body.name: \(B(s)\)
body.construction: For \(s=(n,m,c,K,R,o,\ell)\), set \(T=\sum_{j=0}^{m}m!/(m-j)!\), \(D=2^n3^m\), \(F_0=3^{2n}4^{2m}\), \(N=2^{cK+R}TDF_0\), \(L=o(N+1)\), \(E=(o+8(L+1)^2)^{L+1}\), and \(M=2^{L+1}(\ell+\lceil\log_2(L+2)\rceil)\). Define \(B(s)=(N+1)(E+1)(o+R+1)^3(M+1)\). The factors encode activation truth tables and cells, quotient classes, nonrepeating trace states, factor states, nested forest bitmasks, expression directed acyclic graphs of at most \(L\) nodes, rational row reduction, and worst-case numerator and denominator bit growth.
